title: Search, selection, history, viewport, persistence, and restore

parity_items.compressed-page-boundaries: mr_crabs_terminal::HistoryRead::read_history_line (cold-page read cache) + viewport/search/persist over compressed storage

terminal-additions: ScrollbackStorage::{total_lines, line_cols, read_line, truncate_lines, push_line, clear}
viewport: viewport_row(reader, snapshot, viewport, row) -> Option<ViewportRow> across hot/cold history and visible rows
search: SearchRequest { needle, direction, start, limit, case_sensitive, visible_rows }
SearchWorker::{new, start, cancel, poll, poll_wait, generation, note_history_changed}
SearchMatch/ SearchSpan with per-line spans; MAX_NEEDLE_BYTES=255, DEFAULT_SEARCH_LIMIT=1000, MAX_SEARCH_LIMIT=100000
hyperlinks: hyperlink_at(term, row, col), hyperlink_span(term, row, col) with id/uri
persist: HistoryFile::{capture, encode, decode}; PersistConfig { max_bytes, max_lines, compress }
PersistError::{TooLarge, TooManyLines, VersionMismatch, BadMagic, Corrupt, Truncated}
Versioned MCH8 format (magic/version/flags/chunks/CRC32) with per-chunk LZ4
replay: ReplayLog::{new, record_feed, record_resize, apply, verify, expected_end}

acceptance: s8-history.json contains 26 provenance-cited cases covering search (forward/reverse/limit/start/case/wrapped), viewport hot+cold, selection gestures, persistence roundtrip and rejections, restore equality, deterministic replay, alt-screen history discard, and resize widths
Search results are identical across compressed and uncompressed page boundaries
SearchWorker cancellation reports cancelled=true and stale results are token-rejected; replacement requests win
Persistence rejects corrupt, version-mismatched, bad-magic, truncated, and oversized payloads before allocation
Snapshot restore reproduces the exact captured NormalizedSnapshot and history byte-for-byte
ReplayLog::verify passes for restore + feed/resize replay
Every S8 parity item has exact production ownership (see parity_items) and focused tests in mr-crabs-history
No second terminal model; all reads go through mr-crabs-terminal HistoryRead/storage APIs
constraints: Read the source Ghostty worktree only; do not modify it
